classification.distance: max absolute component difference of within-representative group-mean-normalized P/R/chain profiles

card.scope: Real producer/reducer on four public14SM groups; groups/classes are not physical NUMA domains

fit_timing_scope: CPU-only input loading/serialization plus fit and LOSO wall interval, not processor-cycle time
setup_scope: Already initialized CUDA, selected engine/resources/partial/four prepared slot graphs; input generation separate; single sample per action/bin; explicit DAG/node observation subtracted and recorded; no scientific roster qualification billed.
selection_measurement_scope: 95th percentile of 1000-call batch means over 24 development shapes x four policies x three repeats; not individual request p95; volatile shape loads prevent loop-invariant prediction hoisting; conservative full selection cost, fixed bound steady delta=0.
